name: taskhub
description: Report long-running jobs and agent tasks to the TaskHub Windows tray app: progress, notifications, buttons.
long_description: Tools for AI agents to show their long-running jobs (builds, tests, training, renders, scripts) in the TaskHub tray panel on Windows: start / update / finish a task, wait for it, read the user's button presses, show a notification. Needs the TaskHub app (https://github.com/FelixMUrphy/TaskHub) installed; the tools start it if it is not running and otherwise answer with an error text.

tools.name: notify
tools.description: Show a one-off Windows notification to the user

tools.name: task_start
tools.description: Register a long-running job in the TaskHub panel

tools.name: task_update
tools.description: Report progress / status of a task

tools.name: task_finish
tools.description: Mark a task done, failed or cancelled (the user is notified)

tools.name: task_commands
tools.description: Read the user's button presses / input values for a task

tools.name: task_wait
tools.description: Wait until a task finishes instead of polling
